action_items: tests/test_tscheck_documents.py (pre-existing, prior iteration) POSTs a static-titled document to the shared singleton demo-applicant, which lands with status 'review'. It is not cleaned up afterward, so once pytest executes that file the demo-applicant again carries a review-status document until manually purged. This conflicts with the 'Demo review-queue documents are removed' criterion if that file runs after any admin check in a given pytest worker ordering (pytest-xdist here, so file order across workers isn't guaranteed). It did not cause a failure in this run because test_tscheck_admin_booked_profiles.py executed before test_tscheck_documents.py, but it is a latent flakiness source and a genuine fixture-discipline violation in that older test file (static title '`tscheck-journey-evidence.pdf`' mutates the one real applicant record instead of using an isolated fixture). Recommend giving test_tscheck_documents.py its own unique per-run title and/or a teardown that removes the document it added.

Residual 'tscheck-journey-evidence.pdf' (status review) document was found on the demo-applicant record at the start of this iteration (left over from a previous test run of the file above) and was removed via a direct DB cleanup before re-validating the 'no review documents' criterion.
